Bengaluru gym trainer ‘strangled’ by collagues at anniversary party
articles.description: M Nandan, a 25-year-old gym trainer, was allegedly assaulted to death after a quarrel among trainers. The incident occurred at a flat in Kempapura following the gym's anniversary celebration. Police have arrested three suspects involved in the assault, which reportedly escalated after consuming drugs and alcohol. Nandan's mother filed a complaint, leading to the investigation and arrests.

articles.description: The Mercer County Wildlife Center is diligently working to rehabilitate 219 abandoned box turtles, found near Cranford, New Jersey, back in July. A significant rescue operation was launched after these turtles were discovered by the riverbank. With winter on the horizon, the center is building outdoor enclosures to allow the turtles to brumate naturally.

articles.title: Soldiers looking for land mines in South Korea have found the country's oldest gun dating back to more than 600 years
articles.description: In a fascinating search for hidden landmines, South Korean troops discovered a small bronze gun buried beneath the earth. Dubbed a Hwangja Hwatong, this artifact dates back to the 14th or 15th century. The intricate details engraved on it can help historians piece together Korea's journey in firearm technology and military tactics from the times of the Goryeo and early Joseon dynasties.

articles.title: Rupee falls to 96.39 against dollar as oil rises, FII outflows continue
articles.description: The rupee faced downward pressure against the US dollar, dropping to 96.39 early in the trading session. This decline stems from rising crude oil prices and ongoing selling by foreign investors. Despite this, domestic equities saw gains, softening the rupee's fall. On Monday, Foreign Institutional Investors sold a net Rs 4,699.14 crore in equities, influencing the currency's performance.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Mahakavya producer hints at negative marketing by Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana team
articles.description: 'Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha' producer Prakash Mahobiya has alleged that negative marketing affected the film’s box office performance and claimed that YouTubers and influencers were spreading misinformation about the movie. Without directly naming Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana', he referred to a big-budget film on the same subject. Mahobiya said the makers are planning a re-release and maintained that audiences who watched the film enjoyed it. He also clarified that he cannot confirm who was behind the alleged campaign.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' actor Sunil Lahri warns of drought and shortages
articles.description: Actor Sunil Lahri is raising awareness about the need to conserve essential resources amid drought concerns. He addressed the potential impacts of the El Nino phenomenon on rainfall, agriculture, and resources. The rainfall shortage in Maharashtra has affected agricultural activities in various regions. Lahri draws comparisons to the COVID-19 pandemic, emphasizing preparedness for future resource shortages. He urges individuals to reduce consumption by approximately 15-20% for sustainability.
